description: This file defines a PHP trait named GuardedPropertyTrait within the League\OAuth2\Client\Tool namespace. The trait provides support for blacklisting explicit properties from mass assignment, including methods for filling properties, retrieving guarded properties, and checking if a property is guarded.

methods.name: fillProperties
methods.description: Attempts to mass assign the given options to properties, skipping guarded properties.

methods.name: getGuarded
methods.description: Returns the current list of guarded property names.

methods.name: isGuarded
methods.description: Checks if a specific property is guarded.
